name: cli-report
context: Designing the terminal status report of a long-running job — the visual surface an operator reads.

misfits.text: the verdict is not visible at a glance
color carries meaning a pipe loses
wide lines break on narrow terminals
the report cannot be diffed across runs
clipped evidence pretends to be complete

links.why: a verdict-first layout separates failure from success by position
the provenance line is where truncation is declared
a bounded tail is a bounded width's sibling
dropping color-only signal makes output diffable as text
glanceable banners want width; narrow terminals deny it
a clipped tail aids diffing only if the clip marker is stable
